description: Foundation: TINY test config, models/cascade.py (FrozenStage + composition helpers), checkpoint helpers (load_cascade_source, check_cascade_config, weight_fingerprint, cascade_init_record, cross-level warm_start_model branch) and the five new CLI flags with TrainConfig fields. Plan items 1-3. No Trainer behaviour change yet; level-4 bit-identical.
steps: Read design.md §1-§3, §10, §16 T1-T4, T9-T11, T16 and plan.md items 1-3 first.

tests/runtime_helpers.py: add TINY = dict(filters=(8,16,16,16,16,16), reductions=(16,8), dense=(64,32), decoder_widths=(8,8,8,8,8), dropout=0.0), TINY_ARGS (matching --filters/--reductions/--dense/--decoder-widths CLI list) and tiny_config(**kw) (like narrow_config).

Create models/cascade.py per design §3: PREV_LEVEL={2: 4}, pool_to_coarser (tf.nn.avg_pool3d 2,2,'VALID' on float32), _float32_policy() context manager (save global policy, set 'float32', restore in finally), FrozenStage with from_checkpoint(prefix, cfg) / from_model(model) / from_config(cfg) (construction AND build_model(2) inside _float32_policy, gradient_checkpointing='none'; from_checkpoint restores with runtime.checkpoint._strict_restore; from_model builds a fresh float32 model from model.config and copy_weights_from), attributes .model, .level=4, .fingerprint; linear(images_fine, task) -> stop_gradient(float32 out['A']) with training=False; deform(images_fine) -> {U, U_inv, V} = stop_gradient(diffeo.upsample_displacement(out[u|u_inv|v])); free functions prewarp_linear (L.transform_image(images, tfm.affine_inverse(A_prev), spacing)), compose_linear(R_raw, A_prev, centering), prewarp_deform (diffeo.warp), skip_linear(skip, A_prev) and skip_fields(skip, fields) whose tf.where ops are built under tf.name_scope('cascade_skip'). Module docstring with the conventions (pooling consistency, float32 policy, inference-only). Import runtime.checkpoint lazily if a cycle appears.

runtime/checkpoint.py: add load_cascade_source(path) (resolve_checkpoint; source_config_path must exist; saved['args']['level'] must be 4; info dict with abs checkpoint, abs source_config, source_level 4, source_step=int(tf.train.load_variable(prefix, STEP_KEY)); ValueError otherwise; returns (prefix, ModelConfig, info)), check_cascade_config(model_config, src_cfg) (ValueError naming every differing field, seed excepted), weight_fingerprint(model) ({'n_vars', 'abs_sum' float64, 'sq_sum' float64} over model.weights), cascade_init_record(model, info) returning the §2.2 cascade dict exactly (mode full, via cascade, cross_level [4,2], restored_parts per part len(part.weights) of the level-2 model incl. centering 0, deform_decoder only if present, fresh_parts {}, ignored_source_parts [], n_restored_vars len(model.weights), n_fresh_vars 0, config_diff {}). Do NOT extend DECODER_ONLY_FIELDS.

runtime/checkpoint.py warm_start_model: read the source level from source config.json args.level (absent -> model.level). Same level: existing code untouched (record keeps exactly today's nine keys). Different level: src = GroupRegLevelModel(src_level, src_cfg).build_model(2), _strict_restore(src, prefix); identical configs -> model.copy_weights_from(src), full record; decoder-only diff -> the existing SHARED_PARTS copy loop with src; both add exactly source_level, source_step, cross_level=[src_level, model.level] (§2.3 dicts; partial n_restored_vars = len(pairs); no 'via' key). Update the module docstring.

runtime/args.py: add --cascade-from (str None), --cascade-skip-prob (float 0.0), --bn-recal-batches (int 0), --bn-recal-freeze (str2bool True), --val-pair-chunk (int 16) with help texts; post-parse parser.error rules of §10: cascade requires --level 2, excludes --init-weights, requires --deform-residual-affine false; skip finite and 0<=p<1, p>0 needs --cascade-from; K>=0, K>0 needs --cascade-from with message '--bn-recal-batches > 0 needs --cascade-from (BN recalibration is defined for the level-transfer cascade only)', K>=len(task ratio), --norm batch, not --dry-run; --val-pair-chunk>=1. runtime/run.py TrainConfig: add cascade_skip_prob: float = 0.0 and val_pair_chunk: int = 16 (fields only). train_config_from_args passes both. runtime.args must stay TF-free at import.

Create tests/test_cascade.py (import tests.tf_setup first) with T1(a)(b)(c)(d) TestWeightTransfer (T1(a) writes a level-4 TINY checkpoint + config.json via RunCheckpoint/write_config with args.level=4, asserts every variable array-equal after FrozenStage.from_checkpoint + copy_weights_from, init record == §2.2 dict key by key, main._init_weights_lines(record) is a str; T1(d) prints the measured S rel diff), T2 TestRenderConsistency (NCC > 0.98), T3 TestLinearCascade (numpy Karcher reference with scipy.linalg.logm/expm; float64 1e-5 with tfm.GroupCentering(iters=cfg.centering_iters, dtype='float64'); float32 1e-4 with model.centering; barycenter = I; R = I; pre-warp NCC > 0.99 at level 2; pair predictions = A_j^-1 A_i), T4 TestDeformCascade (zero residual 1e-6; two-level round trip with fd.random_svf max 2 vox, T=7, 3-voxel margin, max <= 0.05 / mean <= 0.01 level-2 voxels, print measured; residual group mean <= 1e-5; deform_loss on out_c equals a manual composed computation), T9 factory part (frozen compute_dtype float32 for all three factories under mixed_float16, global policy mixed_float16 again afterwards; reset policy in tearDown).

tests/test_runtime_infra.py: T10 TestCrossLevelWarmStart (level-4 TINY run -> level-2 model: full and decoder-only partial records equal the §2.3 dicts key by key; _init_weights_lines returns str; level-4 -> level-4 key set unchanged) and T11 + T16 args tests (defaults; every error case listed in §16 T11 incl. --bn-recal-batches 4 without --cascade-from at level 4 and level 2 -> message contains '--cascade-from'; --bn-recal-batches 0 parses; --val-pair-chunk 0 error, default 16; --cascade-from with --deform-residual-affine true error).

Run verification; set this FEAT's status to completed and record in findings: measured T4 round-trip errors, T1(d) S diff, any deviation from the design and exact helper names/signatures later FEATs must use.
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_cascade (T1-T4, T9 factory part) all pass on the GTX 1080 with BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000
tests.test_runtime_infra passes including T10, T11, T16
Golden tests TestLinearOnlyUnchanged and TestDeformUnchanged pass with max |diff| 0

Files: models/cascade.py (new), tests/test_cascade.py (new, 11 tests), runtime/checkpoint.py, runtime/args.py, runtime/run.py (TrainConfig fields only), tests/runtime_helpers.py, tests/test_runtime_infra.py (TestCrossLevelWarmStart + TestArgs.test_cascade_flags), design.md §16 T4 (tolerance revision). VERIFICATION (GTX 1080, BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000, autotune off): tests.test_cascade 11/11 OK; tests.test_runtime_infra all OK (1 dllogger skip); tests.test_diffeo, tests.test_main.TestResumeControlsAndWarmStart OK; goldens '[golden] max |diff| 0' and '[golden deform] max |diff| 0'; py_compile + ast (3,8) OK on the 7 files and `python main.py --help` OK in bgr_preproc38. PRE-EXISTING FLAKE (not caused by this FEAT): tests.test_group_net.TestGradientCheckpointing.test_recompute_matches failed twice when the whole test_group_net module ran (encoder/stem/conv/bias grad diff 1.2e-9-1.5e-9 vs tol 0.9e-9-1.5e-9 = rounding-noise floor on an analytically ~0 gradient) and passed when run alone; it imports only tests.runtime_helpers.NARROW from changed files and models/group_net.py is untouched -> GPU nondeterminism; watch it in the final full-suite run. MEASURED: T1(d) S rel Frobenius diff level 2 vs mode-pooled level 4 = 0.00682 (smooth_phantom ellipsoid mask). T2 interior NCC pooled level-2 render vs level-4 render 0.99982/0.99979/0.99982. T3 barycenter of composed group: rot 1.2e-6 deg, trans 3e-9 mm; pre-warp NCC 0.99997. T4 residual group mean 6e-8..1.2e-7 (raw 1.7-3.4). T4 round trip (level-2 voxels, random_svf max 2 vox per level, T=7): 3-voxel margin u o u_inv max 0.0763 mean 0.01095, u_inv o u max 0.2059 mean 0.01519 -> exceeded provisional 0.05/0.01. Diagnosis: the stages alone give U o U_inv max 0.066/mean 0.0074 and u2 o u2_inv 0.031/0.0069 (SS inverse error; T 9/11 changes < 5 %), and the 0.206 is border clamping (u_inv sampled up to max|u| 4.7 vox outside the interior). DEVIATION (documented in design.md §16 T4, must go into report.md, plan item 16): test uses margin ceil(max|u|)+3 = 8 (measured fwd 0.0604/0.01083, inv 0.0677/0.01502) with max <= 0.1, mean <= 0.02 and composed <= 1.25 x (upsampled-only + residual-only) for max and mean. Other deviations: none in behaviour. load_cascade_source wraps resolve_checkpoint's ValueError as '--cascade-from <path>: <msg>' and also rejects a source config.json without args.level (message 'is level None'); warm_start_model's cross-level branch raises ValueError if the checkpoint has no global step. HELPERS FOR LATER FEATS: models.cascade: PREV_LEVEL={2:4}, FROZEN_LEVEL=4, SKIP_SCOPE='cascade_skip', pool_to_coarser(images)->float32, _float32_policy() ctx manager, FrozenStage(model) with .model/.level/.fingerprint (property -> C.weight_fingerprint), FrozenStage.from_checkpoint(prefix, cfg), FrozenStage.from_model(model), FrozenStage.from_config(cfg) (all build GroupRegLevelModel(4, cfg, gradient_checkpointing='none').build_model(2) under float32 policy), frozen.linear(images_fine, task)->A_prev [N,4,4] float32 stop_gradient, frozen.deform(images_fine)->{'U','U_inv','V'} stop_gradient level-2 voxels, prewarp_linear(images, A_prev, spacing), compose_linear(R_raw, A_prev, centering), prewarp_deform(images, U)->float32, skip_linear(skip, A_prev), skip_fields(skip, fields)->list (tf.where under name scope 'cascade_skip'; skip may be a bool scalar tensor or Python bool). runtime.checkpoint: CASCADE_SOURCE_LEVEL=4, load_cascade_source(path)->(abs prefix, ModelConfig, info{checkpoint, source_config, source_level, source_step}), check_cascade_config(model_config, src_cfg) (ValueError lists all differing fields), weight_fingerprint(model)->{'n_vars','abs_sum','sq_sum'} (python floats, float64 sums in variable order), cascade_init_record(model, info) (§2.2 dict, deform_decoder part only if present), _part_counts(model), _checkpoint_step(prefix). warm_start_model: same-level path unchanged (nine keys); cross-level full/partial add source_level, source_step, cross_level. runtime.args: --cascade-from (args.cascade_from), --cascade-skip-prob (cascade_skip_prob), --bn-recal-batches (bn_recal_batches), --bn-recal-freeze (bn_recal_freeze), --val-pair-chunk (val_pair_chunk, in the deformable group); all §10 parser.error rules implemented in parse_args (exact recal message). TrainConfig.cascade_skip_prob=0.0, TrainConfig.val_pair_chunk=16 (no behaviour yet; train_config_from_args passes both). tests.runtime_helpers: TINY, TINY_ARGS (filters/reductions/dense/decoder-widths only; dropout comes from overfit default 0), tiny_config(**kw). tests/test_cascade.py helpers reusable by FEAT-002..: randomize(model, seed, scale), save_run(root, name, cfg, level_arg=4, step=7, seed=0)->(paths, model), ncc, interior, block_mean, np_center, CascadeCase (tmp dir, resets the Keras policy to float32 in tearDown).
